attchmntText: Lambodhara Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication in respect of the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Lambodhara Textiles Limited submitted copies of newspaper advertisements published on November 7, 2026, declaring financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on November 6, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, total income from operations was 6,620.24 Lakhs, and net profit after tax was 433.94 Lakhs. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, total income from operations was 12,405.22 Lakhs, and net profit after tax was 710.05 Lakhs. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: Lambodhara Textiles Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Lambodhara Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding opening of Special Window for transfer and dematerialization of physical shares and updation of KYC details (Bi-monthly).
